info.title: Figvibe API
info.description: Figvibe E-commerce & Staff Management REST API

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Registration, login, OAuth, sessions, and tokens

tags.name: Users
tags.description: User account management, status, and role assignments

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: Role creation, updating, and permission mapping

tags.name: Cart
tags.description: Shopping cart management, item quantities, and stock availability

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Customer order placement, checkout, status transitions, and address management

tags.name: POS & Physical Store Sales
tags.description: In-store order creation, cash/digital payments, salesman tracking, and store delivery

comparePrice.description: Original or compare price before discount

quantity.description: Quantity of the variant in the cart

unitPrice.description: Unit price at the time of query

isAvailable.description: Whether the variant is active and has sufficient stock

id.description: Unique cart ID, or null if empty

itemCount.description: Number of distinct line items in cart

totalQuantity.description: Total units count of all items combined

subtotal.description: Sum of line totals for all available items

items.description: List of items in the cart

409.description: Email or Username already in use

post.summary: Log in with email and password
Refresh access token via cookie or request body
Log out current session and revoke tokens

get.summary: Get Bearer access token for current session
Get all user roles with permission counts

200.description: List of all system and custom roles

post.summary: Create a new role with optional initial permissions

400.description: Validation error or invalid permission IDs
Cannot delete core system roles or roles with assigned users

put.summary: Assign or sync permissions to a role (replaces existing)

200.description: Permissions assigned and Redis cache invalidated

delete.summary: Remove specific permissions from a role

200.description: Permissions removed and Redis cache invalidated

delete.summary: Permanently delete a user account from database

patch.summary: Assign a role to a user

200.description: User role updated and cache invalidated

patch.summary: Reset user role to default CUSTOMER role
Suspend a user account and revoke all login sessions

post.summary: Revoke all active login sessions for a user

get.description: Fetches the active cart for the authenticated user, including detailed variant attributes, pricing, and live inventory availability.

delete.summary: Clear all items from the cart
delete.description: Deletes all line items from the authenticated user cart in a single atomic transaction.

post.summary: Add an item to the cart
post.description: Adds a product variant to the cart or increments its quantity if already present. Enforces stock validation, maximum distinct items limit, and per-item quantity cap.

400.description: Validation error, insufficient inventory, or cart limit exceeded

404.description: Product variant not found or inactive

patch.description: Updates the quantity of a specific cart item by itemId or variantId. Validates against available stock and max quantity limits.

schema.description: Cart item ID or Product Variant ID

parameters.description: Cart item ID or Product Variant ID
parameters.name: itemId

delete.summary: Remove an item from the cart
delete.description: Deletes a specific line item from the user cart by itemId or variantId.

schema.description: Cart item ID or Product Variant ID

parameters.description: Cart item ID or Product Variant ID
parameters.name: itemId

post.description: Creates a new customer order either directly from their active cart or by specifying explicit items. Validates live inventory, applies coupon discount (if valid), deducts stock, creates a payment record, and clears cart items.

400.description: Validation error, empty cart, or insufficient stock

404.description: Product variant or shipping address not found

get.summary: Get all orders in system (Admin & Staff)
get.description: Lists all orders across all users with filters for status, date range, order number search, and customer lookup.

403.description: Forbidden: Requires ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN, or SALESMAN role

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of orders placed by the authenticated customer.

get.summary: Get order details by ID or order number
get.description: Fetches complete details of an order including line items, shipping address, payment status, and order status.

403.description: Forbidden: Customers cannot view orders of other users

patch.description: Transitions an order status (e.g. PENDING -> CONFIRMED -> PROCESSING -> PACKED -> SHIPPED -> DELIVERED). If cancelled or returned, automatically restocks inventory.

403.description: Forbidden: Requires ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN, or SALESMAN role

post.description: Allows a customer to cancel their order while it is still PENDING, or an Admin anytime before DELIVERED. Restocks inventory and marks payment cancelled/refunded.

400.description: Cannot cancel order in current status

get.description: Returns all saved shipping addresses for the authenticated user.

post.description: Saves a new shipping address to the authenticated customer account.

Salesman creates an order for a walk-in or registered customer directly from the physical store. Deducts live stock, records payment (CASH or MFS/Card with transactionId), links order to the salesman, and sends an optional invoice email.

403.description: Forbidden: Requires SALESMAN, ADMIN, or SUPER_ADMIN role

get.description: Retrieves all physical store orders created by the logged-in salesman with date and status filters.

200.description: List of sales created by the salesman

get.description: Returns today's, this week's, and this month's revenue, order counts, and top-selling variants for the logged-in salesman.

patch.summary: Process store order delivery or handover
patch.description: Updates delivery status of an in-store order (e.g., mark as DELIVERED upon customer handover).

post.summary: Send or resend invoice email to customer
post.description: Dispatches a digital receipt/invoice to the customer email address via background BullMQ worker.

get.description: Lists all physical store sales across all salesmen and outlets with filtering by salesman, date range, and payment method.

403.description: Forbidden: Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role

get.description: Provides a revenue and order volume breakdown for each salesman over a selectable date range.

403.description: Forbidden: Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role

get.description: Tracks which product variants were sold, total quantities, and revenue generated, filterable by salesman.

403.description: Forbidden: Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role
